title: I dream almost every night about the same places
content: I have posted this on a few of the posts but wanted to make my experience more scene, there’s many more places that are in my dream as well but these are usually the main. Yes there is a amusement park with water slide , there bar I see is almost underground, I have to go through what looks like a big yellow dome that’s attached to a cave that goes underground next to the water slide , the water slide is usual red or red with strips and has those tubes, the bar almost looks like a cruise ship bar or like one of the buffets in Vegas . It’s a huge circle that goes all the way around the middle of the room with the bottles big booths are attached to the walls all in a circle as well, the bar always seems like it has a tiny of yellow in it, the counter tops are pure white or a white marble . Servers dressed with white button up and a black vest suite no jacket. And black bow ties usually all men. and in my dreams the airport has a circle in the middle and the circle is where the plane sits while everyone is boarding and then it’s lifted from underground into the sky for takeoff, always a very large double decker, usually very light blue metallic like . As for the hotel one of the hotel rooms has a ocean right out where the balcony should be , the water is calm but overflowing over the balcony and the room has drains to help the water flow out, almost looks like the future with seawater rise , I also visit almost like a military storage that has a bunch of large black shipping containers. There’s also a certain gas station that’s in the middle of nowhere , always dark out, usually it’s very empty, it has a ramp up to it , almost looks like a old cabin. It has 2 pumps out front and a wood fence that’s has paint chipped around it . There is also a very large freeway I dream of constantly, it’s a very very steep slope, to the point I feel fear in my dream trying to drive up it, I never make it to the top, my car is always rolling down . Also the mall, everything everyone is saying about the mall/ amusement park is just like in my dreams ….. There’s also a ocean with a ton of cliffs and grass around it, it seems to always be sunset when I’m there. There also a office building that has many windows, many floors at least 15 or more, it’s always a maze , and in that building I’m always running from what seems like security that looks like men in black and I am trying to get in a room with a big machine that’s a huge silver box the size of a mini van. It’s almost like a chamber because it has a door with a clear window.
